manifest.summary: Writes book- and series-length fiction with a local Jan model. You give it a premise (or let Free-Rein invent one), it builds a world and cast, plans a chapter outline, then drafts scene by scene while tracking a living world codex. Exports to EPUB/PDF/TXT and reads the book aloud as an offline audiobook.

features.name: Home
features.description: Project list with per-book stats and cover thumbnails; create/open a project.

features.name: Story
features.description: Story bible (title, genre, protagonist, plot, pinned facts, inspiration, style directives). Free-Rein: a multi-pass world + cast + places + open-threads build scaled by the world-depth setting, seeded from whatever fields are filled. Generate Outline turns the bible into a numbered chapter list.

features.name: Generate
features.description: Scene-by-scene drafting toward a per-chapter word target. RAM guard pauses/stops cleanly and resumably when free memory is low; degeneration guard aborts and retries a scene that loops; DRY sampling anti-repetition. Live token stream, soft stop, hard stop.

features.name: World Codex
features.description: Structured characters / locations / factions / facts, auto-updated as chapters are written, with periodic contradiction-reconcile sweeps.

features.name: References
features.description: Style library built from PDFs: ingest a book, analyse its house style, fold it into every scene. Best-effort DuckDuckGo research notes.

features.name: Continue a Series
features.description: Never-ending-story mode: ingest 1-12 PDFs of an existing series, learn its style, measure its POV/tense, rebuild the codex, then write N more chapters at a time with a chosen spin (alternate POV, time-skip, spin-off, genre shift, what-if).

features.name: Series
features.description: Multi-book arcs: planned book count, arc synopsis, per-book status; each book's outline is shaped by the shared arc.

features.name: Export
features.description: EPUB (real nav/TOC + Calibre series index), PDF (A4/Letter), TXT; whole-series export reuses the per-book path. Procedural cover art (gradient/duotone/minimal, Pillow only) plus import and light edits. AI cover is a deliberate stub behind diffusers/torch.

features.name: Audiobook (in Export)
features.description: Offline TTS via Piper and Kokoro. Modes: single narrator, full cast, or one narrator doing per-character pitch/pace shifts. Regex dialogue attribution, per-character voice map, LLM casting director, ffmpeg-stitched output with real chapter markers.

features.name: Settings
features.description: Jan API base, models folder, world depth, sampling, RAM guard threshold, export/cover/audiobook defaults, UI scale/density.

services: Jan / llama.cpp @ http://localhost:1337/v1 (required for all generation; models also discovered by scanning Jan's llamacpp/models folder)

optional: diffusers + torch - local AI cover art (stub until installed; minutes per image on this CPU-only box)

manifest.standalone_launch: .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn web_app:app --port 8421   (run.py still launches the legacy customtkinter desktop app)
manifest.api_base: /api/  (49 routes in web_app.py: projects, bible, outline, generate, free-rein, continuation, series, jobs+SSE, state, refresh-models, settings, export, cover, style-sources, research, tts, voice-map, audiobook)
known_gaps: Free-Rein web endpoint restored 2026-09-07 but not yet run against a live model.
Continuation mode not yet run end-to-end against real series PDFs.
narrator_voices auto pitch slots are assigned alphabetically, so a character can land on a wrong-sounding voice unless set explicitly.
research.py uses DuckDuckGo Instant Answers (often empty) - explicitly best-effort.
Theme change needs an app restart.
